summary.headline: Planetary Aspects and Public Omens
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of the Moon–Jupiter and Sun–Mars square, opposition, and conjunction, including conflict among scholars, rulers, judges, merchants, and soldiers, social unrest, weather changes, currency debasement, and directional omens based on Mars’s elemental sign. Muhyi al-Din al-Maghribi is cited on harm reaching the king from the east, west, south, or north.
